Buy a Green Card on Telegram

The advertised price for a green card on Telegram usually sits between 800 USD. Anything far below that band is a print and anything far above it should come with a register check you can run yourself.

What it proves
A green card is the United States permanent resident card. Outside the United States the same job is done by a permanent residence card, and sellers use the American term loosely for every country.

buy green card on telegram – the short version

For a green card the realistic expectation is 800 USD and one to three weeks of waiting. Same day delivery at the bottom of the band usually means a digital file rather than a card.

Read the price table before you open a chat, not after. Knowing the band stops you anchoring on whatever number the seller opens with.

The band you should expect for a green card is 800 USD. Below the bottom you are buying a print and should be told so. Above the top you should be getting a number that was registered rather than invented.

buy green card via telegram: how it works in practice

The transaction runs in a private chat, usually after a public channel advert. That is fine. What matters is that the sequence is fixed before money moves: photos first, then a number check, then payment, then tracked delivery.

Some sellers will push for the full amount up front. Offer the deposit and hold firm on the balance. Most accept and the ones who do not are usually reselling stock they do not have.

Ask for the issue date and the issuing office before you ask the price. A seller working with the national issuing authority stock answers instantly. A reseller has to go and look, and that pause tells you where you sit in the chain.

What you should actually receive

A complete green card is a set of things, not a single image. Insist on all five before any money moves.

  • A card with your photo, alien registration number and class of admission.
  • The card expiry date and the conditions attached to the status.
  • The security features of the issuing office, from optical variable ink to laser-engraved personalisation.
  • An alien or residence number that follows the authority format.
  • A record in the immigration register that the number resolves against.

Who actually issues a green card

It helps to know that the national issuing authority does not sell to the public through Telegram. The chain always ends at that office and the register it keeps is the only authority that counts.

If the seller names a different office, that is not automatically wrong. the national issuing authority may delegate. But the answer should be specific enough to be checkable, and vague regional answers are not.

Replica or registered original

Replica and registered original are used interchangeably in adverts and they are not the same purchase. A replica is a print. It copies the layout and fails on UV, on substrate and on the number.

The failure modes are different too. A print fails the first UV torch. Stock fails the number. A registered original fails only if the entry has lapsed or the details do not match it.

What a fair price looks like

Treat 800 USD as the market for a green card and every deviation as a claim to be tested. A high price is a promise of quality, so make the seller keep it.

The honest summary is that you get what the tier buys. Pay the print price for a print, the stock price for stock, and the top price only when somebody proves the number.

The buying process, step by step

Follow these in sequence and stop at the first one that fails.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the national issuing authority.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the national issuing authority uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 800 USD band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

These are the checks that separate a real green card from a good print. All of them are cheap to run and two are local to the country in question.

  • Check the number format. Residence numbers are structured, never free text.
  • Compare the personal details against the passport used for the application.
  • Look for the optical variable element, which shifts colour when tilted.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the national issuing authority. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

Red flags specific to the country in question, plus the generic tells that apply anywhere.

  • A residence number that is the same length as a passport number but with no structure.
  • A card described as permanent with an expiry date inside two years.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

What does a green card cost on Telegram?

Between 350 and 1600 US dollars. The top of the band is where a number that resolves at the immigration office should sit.

Is a green card the same as a residence permit?

In the United States yes, in practice. Elsewhere the green card is the permanent tier and the residence permit is the fixed term tier below it.

Can the number be checked?

Only against the immigration register. Ask the seller which register the number sits in and expect a specific answer.

Why are green cards so expensive?

Because the number carries the most weight of any document here and the register check is the hardest to fake.

What is the usual fake?

A high quality print of a real card with the number left intact and the personal details changed.

Before you pay

Start with the authority and the number, then work outward. The contact page is open if you want a second pair of eyes.
